promotion: Rewrite only: the lookup base entity and its EF configuration base were read as references and rebuilt fresh with starter names in Starter.Domain/Lookups and the Lookups module (generic tables seeded only by migrations, cached read API, activate/deactivate). The reference-data application services are a geo (airport) sync and were not carried: no geo data enters the starter. "target" is the repo file an entry informed, "stagedTarget" the path in the staging folder; a rewritten file hash differs from stagedSha256.

Read for the configuration pattern only (fixed ids, ValueGeneratedNever, required bilingual names).
